changeSet.author: folio-droplock
changeSet.comment: nexus.drop_tenant_partitions locks nexus.chunks and nexus.taxonomy_centroids ACCESS EXCLUSIVE (one statement, roots first, five attempts of 500 ms with a 0.2 s * attempt backoff, then lock_not_available naming the tenant) after its three DELETEs and before its detach loop, so it cannot deadlock with a search, which also takes the root first; it raises a NOTICE with the attempt taken and the hold time. Held from the first DETACH to commit; searches queue behind a waiting request for at most 500 ms at a time. SECURITY INVOKER, EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC (kept by CREATE OR REPLACE), no grant. No DATA EFFECT: a function redefinition only; no row is changed by this changeset.
